legacy.text: Skip to main content CrowAgent Products Pricing Blog FAQ About ⌘K Sign in Request access BY SECTOR The statute behind your sector. Different rules, one product. See what your sector's tender is actually scored on, and how CrowMark for Suppliers answers it. WHO WE BUILD FOR Every sector is under its own clock. Nine UK sectors, each with its own bidding pressure. One line on the pressure, and how CrowMark answers it. Public-Sector Suppliers PPN 002, dated February 2025 and mandatory from 1 October 2025, makes social value a scored 10% minimum weighting on in-scope central-government tenders. CrowMark IT Managed Service Providers Public-sector IT and managed-service tenders are scored on PPN 002 social value alongside technical fit and price. CrowMark Professional Services Framework call-offs and mini-competitions score PPN 002 social value alongside price, so a reused answer has to hold up every time it is scored again. CrowMark Construction Public works bids score PPN 002 social value against a 10% minimum weighting. CrowMark Facilities Management FM tenders turn on TUPE, mobilisation and evidenced delivery against the published KPIs. CrowMark Highways Term-maintenance and NEC4 contracts are scored on social value alongside price and capability. CrowMark NHS Suppliers Framework bids weigh PPN 002 social value alongside a track record of on-time, evidenced delivery. CrowMark Education Public-sector contracts expect a consistent, well-evidenced bid and a track record of on-time delivery. CrowMark Charities Grant and tender bids are judged on PPN 002 social value, with reporting that has to stay lean. CrowMark Bids and contracts grouped by sector in CrowMark Analytics, shown with a sample account. Every number on screen is that sample account’s own data. It is not a customer result and not an outcome to expect. HOW CROWMARK WORKS Whatever your sector, the answer is cited. CrowMark reads the rules behind the tender, so every score, weighting and figure traces back to its source. CROWMARK Social value computed in code on the PPN 002 model at the 10% minimum weighting, over a curated catalogue of TOMs-aligned measures, with answers drafted from your own submitted bids.
